The upstream README and page footer license the website under:
Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International License
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/

The upstream footer asks derivative websites to link back to the original
Nerfies page in their footer. The OaP site adapts the academic title, author,
resource-button and section layout for its own content.

Third-party components have their own licenses, documented in
THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md. The Nerfies authors' research text, photos, videos,
analytics, carousel and slider scripts are not distributed here.
